Description Define one or more variants for the artifacts of a VFB system. Defining one variant means creating a Predefined Variant related to the settings used by the VFB elements in scope. T o do so, this task can make use of existing System Constant Value Sets and/or Postbuid Variant Sets or define new ones. Several Predefined Variants can be combined to one Evaluated Variant Set.
